i.norm: Verifies that merging a Hasher into a SparseBloomFilter and then merging the populated filter with itself (as a BitMapExtractor) both succeed. After the first merge the filter contains the bits produced by the hasher. The second merge re-adds those same bits (self-merge via BitMapExtractor), which is an idempotent operation. Both calls must return {@code true}.
Arrange: a shape with 833 bits and 833 hash functions
A double hasher whose bit indices are derived from seed=-782 and increment=3371
Act: populate the filter from the hasher, then merge the filter with itself
Assert: both merge operations must report success and agree on the result
